name: Playtest Save Isolation
author: gba_world playtest project
description: Inert unless the GBAWORLD_PLAYTEST_SAVEDIR environment variable is set at launch. When set, redirects SaveData::SAVE_DIR to that folder so QA playthroughs of gba_world-ported games never read or write the player's real save files under %APPDATA%/infinitefusion.
